description: This file defines the VoicemailProviderHelper interface, which provides methods for manipulating voicemails within a content provider, including inserting, updating, deleting, and retrieving voicemails, as well as setting voicemail content.

classes.name: VoicemailProviderHelper
classes.description: An interface providing methods to manipulate voicemails in the content provider, including CRUD operations and content setting.

classes.name: SortOrder
classes.description: An enum defining sorting options for voicemail retrieval: ASCENDING, DESCENDING, DEFAULT.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all voicemails accessible to the content provider, returning the count of deleted voicemails.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new voicemail into the content provider, returning the Uri of the inserted voicemail.

methods.name: findVoicemailBySourceData
methods.description: Finds a voicemail matching the given provider data, returning the Voicemail object or null.

methods.name: findVoicemailByUri
methods.description: Finds a voicemail by its Uri, returning the Voicemail object or null.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing voicemail identified by Uri with provided Voicemail data, returning the number of rows updated.

methods.name: setVoicemailContent
methods.description: Sets voicemail content from an InputStream or byte array, given the voicemail Uri and MIME type.

methods.name: getAllVoicemails
methods.description: Retrieves all voicemails without specific order.

methods.name: getAllVoicemails
methods.description: Retrieves all voicemails with filtering, sorting by specified column and order.

methods.name: getUriForVoicemailWithId
methods.description: Returns the Uri for a voicemail with the specified message Id.
